name: Sovereign Pipeline
description: Privacy-first training/data/eval loop for AIDE. Fully local by default. Bundles the local model lane (North-Mini-Code 1.0 as the sovereign agent), the training SOP, dataset ingestion + dedupe skills, QLoRA runner, GGUF export, and battery-driven promotion. The bundle is the canonical recipe for going from raw data to a verified, registered adapter on disk.

privacy_doctrine.notes: No route in this bundle performs network egress. Cloud training is disabled by default; local GPU/CPU only.

credo_excerpt: Earn trust through evidence, never verbal confidence alone.
Follow the assigned SOP and stop when a gate fails.
A generated answer is a proposal until Veritas validates it.
dos: Verify every dataset row is unique against the corpus index before staging (zero-dup-high-quality).
Run Veritas after every stage transition.
Log every training run to .aide/trajectories/ with sha256 of inputs.
Use a checkpoint before any weight mutation.
Run the full battery on the new adapter before promoting.
donts: Do not start a training run if GPU memory pressure > 80%.
Do not modify weights in-place; always checkpoint first.
Do not trust a model's claim that a training run succeeded without eval battery results.
Do not train on data with no provenance.
Do not skip dedup just because the corpus is small.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ with torch 2.7.1+cu118, transformers, peft, trl, bitsandbytes
GPU with >= 8 GB free VRAM (16 GB recommended)
Base model: North-Mini-Code 1.0 GGUF at E:/models/north-mini-code/
Git workspace for the adapter (recommended; not required)

steps.label: Census: confirm model, GPU, data, deps
steps.description: Run aide-doctor: model engine up, GPU + Vulkan detected, training deps installed, dataset dir writable.

steps.label: Ingest + dedupe training data
steps.description: Read source data, dedupe vs the corpus index, write manifest with row counts + sha256 of inputs + dedup pass rate.

steps.label: Run QLoRA SFT
steps.description: Configure QLoRA (4-bit, rank 16, alpha 32). Train until loss is monotonically decreasing. Checkpoint every N steps.

steps.label: Export adapter to GGUF
steps.description: Merge adapter into base, quantize to Q4_K_M, write to E:/models/<run-id>/adapter.gguf, generate .profile.json sidecar.

steps.label: Register adapter + run battery
steps.description: Add to models/manifest.json, restart daemons, run aide-task-verification-battery, confirm new adapter scores >= base on same prompts.

workflow.completion_criterion: adapter registered in manifest.json AND battery-gain > 0 AND veritas passed all 5 steps AND human approved the promotion

setup: Read the training-sop skill before the first session.
Verify the recommended local models: GET /api/models shows status ready.
MCP servers install disabled. Trust each one with `aide-bundle trust sovereign-pipeline <server>`.
Confirm GPU has >= 8 GB free VRAM before starting a training run.
The training data must live in .aide/training-data/<run-id>/ (one dir per run).
